The '''Senate Landing Platform''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was a landing platform used to receive dignataries during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was sometimes there.
